definition.choose: bridge_choose(state, query, candidates) reads the query through the attached bridge; it chooses only when exactly one entity is read and that entity is in candidates
definition.exits: no_bridge (no table), no_choice (no answer), ambiguous_read (more than one answer), not_in_candidates (one answer outside the candidate list), chosen
definition.inert: no choice path changes any parameter, h, fast, nu_ema, coverage, prior or sc_sfk
definition.correction: correcting the RED alias to GREEN flips its choice in [RED, GREEN] from index 0 to 1; the table digest moves and the subject hashes do not
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.chosen: CUP->0 and RED->1 in [CUP, RED]; RED->0 in [RED, GREEN]
criteria.no_choice: unknown query gives no_choice with read_decision=no_match
criteria.ambiguous: two-entity query gives ambiguous_read and answers=2
criteria.not_in_candidates: CUP read with [RED, GREEN] gives not_in_candidates
criteria.no_bridge: a state without a table gives no_bridge
criteria.correction: before correction RED->0; after RED->1; table digest changes; subject hashes equal
criteria.inert: parameter and state hashes equal before and after all choices
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: R24 and R25 each carry a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
